title: Department Checklist
description: Draft department checklist items derived from GSP Standard candidates and evidence matrix records via LLM semantic analysis (C6B). Each item is a verification question for department owners and auditors.

checklist_item_id.description: C6B: Canonical checklist item ID (e.g., CL-GSP-COM-P04-SWM-001-001).

checklist_set_id.description: C6B: Group identifier linking checklist items from the same generation batch.

linked_customer_requirement_ids.description: C6B: CRM IDs linked via the GSP standard.

linked_evidence_ids.description: C6B: Evidence matrix IDs linked to the same GSP standard.

checklist_question.description: C6B: The verification question or check point for the auditor/department owner.

check_purpose.description: C6B: Why this check is needed — what risk or requirement it addresses.

check_method.description: C6B: How to perform the check (e.g., 'Review records', 'Site inspection', 'Interview workers').

expected_result.description: C6B: What a passing result looks like (the expected state).

required_evidence.description: C6B: What evidence should be available to demonstrate compliance with this check.

responsible_function.description: C6B: Function accountable for this checklist item.

responsible_department.description: C6B: Department responsible for this checklist item.

suggested_frequency.description: C6B: Suggested frequency for performing this check.

risk_level.description: C6B: Risk level if this check is not performed or fails.

checklist_type.description: C6B: Type of check to be performed.

site_scope.description: C6B: Which sites/facilities this check applies to.

applicability.description: C6B: Conditions or exceptions for applicability.

llm_reasoning_summary.description: C6B: Summary of why the LLM proposed this checklist item.

uncertainty_notes.description: C6B: Notes about uncertainty, ambiguity, or alternative interpretations.

needs_human_review.description: C6B: True if LLM flagged uncertainty needing human verification.

generation_method.description: C6B: How this checklist item was generated.

review_status.description: C6B: Initial status is always draft_pending_review.

approval_status.description: C6B: Initial status is always not_approved.

generated_by.description: C6B: System that generated this record.

batch_id.description: C6B: Batch identifier for the generation run.

sample_only.description: C6B: True if based on sample candidates.

created_by.description: C6B: User ID or system that created this record.
